title: Пет-проект (личный): micro-llm
text: Пет-проект (личный): micro-llm — Языковая модель GPT с нуля на PyTorch. Токенайзер BPE (байтовый, как в GPT-2) и трансформер написаны вручную: внимание, маска, остаточные связи, инициализация. Цикл обучения с AdamW, прогревом и косинусным расписанием, проверочная выборка, генерация с temperature, top-k и top-p. Выгрузка карт внимания в JSON для 3D-визуализации. 845 тысяч параметров учатся за 105 секунд на Apple M4 Pro; символьный токенайзер и BPE сравниваются в «битах на байт». 20 тестов, подробный учебник с упражнениями на русском. Дальше: токенайзер на Rust/WASM и запуск модели в браузере. Стек: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, BPE, pytest. Репозиторий: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/micro-llm.

Markdown дорисовывается по ходу, незакрытый блок кода остаётся кодом, HTML из ответа не выполняется. Остановка по кнопке и Esc с сохранением уже полученного текста, повтор после обрыва, вызовы инструментов с карточками, калькулятор без eval. Токены применяются пачкой раз в кадр, автопрокрутка не мешает читать, скринридер слышит начало и конец ответа, а не каждый токен. Сервер модели работает в браузере. 100 тестов, включая axe. Стек: React, TypeScript, SSE, zustand, Accessibility (WAI-ARIA). Демо: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/potok/. Репозиторий: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/potok.

title: Пет-проект (личный): Пропуск
text: Пет-проект (личный): Пропуск — Авторизация, сделанная как в продукте. Access-токен (JWT) в памяти и refresh-токен в HttpOnly-cookie с ротацией и обнаружением кражи; пароли на PBKDF2 с защитой от перебора и одинаковыми ошибками. Двухфакторная защита (TOTP, коды восстановления), ключи доступа (WebAuthn), вход через провайдера по OAuth 2.0 + PKCE + OpenID Connect, ссылки из писем, устройства, режим судо, роли. Клиент обновляет токен один раз на все запросы и вкладки (Web Locks), выходит во всех вкладках (BroadcastChannel). Сервер на Hono работает и на Node, и в браузере. 62 теста, включая passkeys в Playwright. Стек: React, TypeScript, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, WebAuthn, Hono. Демо: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/propusk/. title: Side project (personal): micro-llm
text: Side project (personal): micro-llm — A GPT language model from scratch in PyTorch. A byte-level BPE tokenizer (as in GPT-2) and a transformer written by hand: attention, causal mask, residual connections, initialization. A training loop with AdamW, warmup and cosine schedule, a validation split, sampling with temperature, top-k and top-p. Attention maps exported to JSON for 3D visualization. 845k parameters train in 105 seconds on an Apple M4 Pro; the character tokenizer and BPE are compared in bits per byte. 20 tests and a detailed step-by-step tutorial with exercises (in Russian). Next: a Rust/WASM tokenizer and running the model in the browser. Stack: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, BPE, pytest. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/micro-llm.

title: Side project (personal): Potok
text: Side project (personal): Potok — Streaming AI chat. The answer streams over SSE: a hand-written parser survives an event being cut anywhere, even mid-character. Markdown renders as it arrives, an unclosed code block stays code, HTML in the answer never runs. Stop by button or Esc keeping the text received so far, retry after a dropped connection, tool calls with cards, a calculator without eval. Tokens are applied in one batch per frame, auto-scroll never fights the reader, and a screen reader hears the start and end of an answer, not every token. The model server runs in the browser. 100 tests, including axe. Stack: React, TypeScript, SSE, zustand, Accessibility (WAI-ARIA). Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/potok/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/potok.

Places by day: drag and drop with mouse, touch and keyboard, a MapLibre route map — the camera flies to the selected day and the route draws itself. Popular sights from Wikidata with photos, weather forecast, a serverless share link, calendar export. Next.js static export, logic covered by tests. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand, TanStack Query, MapLibre. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/tropa/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/tropa.

title: Side project (personal): Resonance
text: Side project (personal): Resonance — Music visualizer. Three shader-driven 3D scenes that listen to music: a noise sphere, a 60,000-particle galaxy, a synthwave landscape built from spectrum history. Audio analysis with frequency bands and beat detection, a demo track synthesized in the browser with Web Audio, your own file or microphone. 60 fps, tutorial-style docs. Stack: React Three Fiber, TypeScript, GLSL, Web Audio, Vitest. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/resonance/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/resonance.

title: Side project (personal): 3D Constructor
text: Side project (personal): 3D Constructor — WebGL animation builder with code export. 40 effects tuned with sliders; the code is exported as a JS module, a React component or a web component — the same runtime that renders the preview, about 8 KB gzipped. GLSL backgrounds (a sea with a day cycle and storms, Perlin-Worley clouds, space, fire, liquid metal), GPU fluid simulations, transitions that burn through a real HTML section, cursors, a liquid button, a preloader, three.js 3D. Write your own shader in the editor, motion paths, adaptive quality. The home page is a GSAP scroll scene built from the same effects. 131 tests, a 17-chapter tutorial. Stack: WebGL2 / GLSL, Three.js, GSAP, React, TypeScript. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/konstruktor-3d/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/konstruktor-3d.

title: Side project (personal): Letuchka
text: Side project (personal): Letuchka — Team retrospective board. A room by link, no sign-up: cards, voting, a timer, teammates’ cursors and reactions in real time. Three phases: write blind, vote, discuss. Supabase backend: anonymous auth, Postgres, row level security, realtime; a serverless demo mode across browser tabs. Stack: Nuxt, Vue 3, Pinia, Supabase, TypeScript. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/letuchka/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/letuchka.

title: Side project (personal): Myata
text: Side project (personal): Myata — Telegram Mini App for salon booking. Book a master right inside Telegram: service, master, free slot, confirmation. Uses the user’s theme colors, native Telegram buttons (MainButton, BackButton), haptics, bookings in CloudStorage synced across devices. Scheduling respects service duration with an “any master” mode; a demo mode outside Telegram. Stack: React, TypeScript, Telegram Mini Apps, Zustand, Vite. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/myata/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/myata.

title: Side project (personal): Ritm
text: Side project (personal): Ritm — Mobile app: habit tracker. A React Native + Expo app: one codebase for iOS, Android and the web. Habits by weekday, counters, streaks, stats with a heatmap. Swipe to check off — the gesture and animation run on the UI thread (Gesture Handler, Reanimated), with an SVG progress ring. On-device data with versioning and migration, local reminders, haptics, dark theme, accessibility. Stack: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Reanimated, Zustand. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/ritm/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/ritm.

title: Side project (personal): Propusk
text: Side project (personal): Propusk — Production-grade authentication. A JWT access token in memory and a refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie with rotation and theft detection; PBKDF2 passwords with brute-force protection and uniform errors. Two-factor auth (TOTP, recovery codes), passkeys (WebAuthn), sign-in via a provider with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE + OpenID Connect, email links, devices, sudo mode, roles. The client refreshes once for all requests and tabs (Web Locks) and logs out everywhere (BroadcastChannel). The Hono server runs both on Node and in the browser. 62 tests, including passkeys in Playwright. Stack: React, TypeScript, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, WebAuthn, Hono. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/propusk/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/propusk.

title: Side project (personal): Saldo
text: Side project (personal): Saldo — Personal finance app on Redux Toolkit and FSD. RTK Query: a single createApi with endpoints injected per entity and tags — after any change the list, balances, charts and budgets refresh themselves; optimistic edits with rollback. Undoable delete via listener middleware, a CSV import wizard on createSlice and createSelector (encoding, columns and categories are detected, duplicates skipped). Feature-Sliced Design architecture enforced by Steiger. Forms with react-hook-form + zod, money in minor units, Recharts charts. 75 tests: Vitest with MSW and Playwright. Stack: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Feature-Sliced Design. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/saldo/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/saldo.

title: Side project (personal): Prilavok
text: Side project (personal): Prilavok — Real-time e-commerce admin panel. A hand-written WebSocket client: reconnection with exponential backoff and jitter, heartbeat, channels, acknowledged requests, an offline queue and resuming missed events by sequence number and server epoch. Events flow into the TanStack Query cache; record versions guard against races. A server-side table with URL state, 10,000 virtualized rows, optimistic updates, roles. The server runs in the browser via MSW and on Node. 138 tests. Stack: React, TypeScript, WebSocket, TanStack Router / Query / Table, shadcn/ui. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/prilavok/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/prilavok.

title: Side project (personal): Opora
text: Side project (personal): Opora — React component library. 16 accessible components built without Radix or other headless foundations: a dialog with a focus trap and inert, arrow-key navigation in menus and tabs, a select using aria-activedescendant, toasts as live regions, custom positioning with flip and shift. Styles in cascade layers and tokens — overridable without !important. Package: ESM, types, an exports map, publint and attw checks, installing the packed tarball with SSR. 133 tests with axe, Storybook. Stack: React, TypeScript, Accessibility (WAI-ARIA), Storybook, Vitest. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/opora/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/opora.

title: Side project (personal): Sosny Residence
text: Side project (personal): Sosny Residence — Residential complex website. A three.js 3D block: hover a tower to see available flats. A catalog of 270 flats with filters, a floor grid and URL state. Static flat pages with SVG floor plans, favorites, a mortgage calculator. Stack: Astro, TypeScript, Three.js, GSAP, SCSS. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/zhk-sosny/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/zhk-sosny.

title: Side project (personal): ORBITA
text: Side project (personal): ORBITA — Space agency website. A 3D rocket follows its trajectory as you scroll, and on “Launch” flies it back and lands on the pad. All 16 GSAP plugins, six library-free sliders, shader transitions, GPU water simulation, an infinite gallery. Three pages, 120 fps, 218 tests. Stack: GSAP, Three.js, GLSL, Vite, Vitest. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/space-agency/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/space-agency.

title: Side project (personal): frontend-kit
text: Side project (personal): frontend-kit — Project starter kit. 36 modules, zod-style form schemas and masks, Swiper, 3D slider, i18n, dev panel, 4 starters: vanilla, React, React + TS, Astro. This site is built with it. Stack: TypeScript, Astro, React, SCSS, GSAP. Demo: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/frontend-kit/. Repository: https://github.com/dmitriy9427/frontend-kit.

title: 3D version of the resume
text: The 3D version of the resume is an interactive walk through a night city: a room on a high floor, a descent to the street, signs with projects and experience, and a seaside finish. Built with Astro, React Three Fiber, three.js and Blender. URL: https://dmitriy9427.github.io/3d-resume/
